name: Paris
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at the diameter JPL lists; not three measured axes.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, physical parameters for 3317 Paris: diameter 118.79 ± 1.175 km; JPL's stated reference: urn:nasa:pds:neowise_diameters_albedos::2.0[jupiter_trojans] (http://adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2012ApJ...759...49G)
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at the 118.79 km diameter the JPL Small-Body Database lists for Paris. No shape model is published.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed color or terrain.
introduction: Paris was found at Palomar on 26 May 1984.
datasetSummary: A sphere at the 118.79 km diameter JPL lists. Its shape and pole are not measured.
